description: Hand-authored known-answer fixture for scripts/eval_harness/semantic_selection_eval.py. The 4-dimensional vectors are synthetic and were not produced by any encoder, so this file documents the contract and the cosine arithmetic only; it says nothing about model quality. ctx-* are approved context candidates and form the only ranking pool. decoy-x is denied with cosine 1.0 to q-2 and must never rank or be selected. policy-1 explicitly declares global protected_scope in v2: it must never rank and must appear in every frozen pack for every query. Image-local protected records instead declare kind=queries and their frozen query_ids; unrelated packs must omit them. The all-zero revision is a synthetic shape placeholder, not an immutable model pin. q-3 has no gold ids and is reported as no_relevant, not dropped. Expected: top1 = 1/3 and MRR = 4/9 over the three frozen queries.
